A readiness sample floor must be derived from the LIVE cadence, not the default knob. The 200-selection floor assumed e3_steps_per_tick=10; the MECH-093-modulated 5-20-step cadence gives 180-720 selections for the same window, so any floor keyed to the default fires spuriously on arousal-slow cells.

The arm-scoped precondition pattern exists (794's per_arm_gate, 737's recorded_preconditions) and is not being adopted uniformly. The indexer's _compute_adjudication is flat and arm-blind BY DESIGN, so the driver is the only place this can be fixed -- a driver omitting the pattern silently converts one bad control cell into a whole-run refusal. Worth a manifest-local lint.
